text:
The rose was left written in the air.

Morning wrote it with a delicate pulse.

And, setting its cheek against the window

of light, it keeps its appointment with the blue.


Almost perfect and without reason it meditates,

absorbed in its vain beauty;

forgetting does not touch it, nor does the daisy

trouble it with her sorrow of love.


To the moon alone it stretches arms

of fragrance, and walks with secret steps

of fragrance, nothing more, toward its star.


It exists, inaccessible to the one who sings it,

ignorant of all its thorns,

while the nightingale dies for it.

translation.title: The Rose Was Left Written in the Air...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the rose as written air: unreachable, thornless to itself, fatal to the nightingale.
